title: transpose kernel is 2-3× slower than expected on BW151
description: Tiled transpose kernel produces correct output but runs 2-3× slower than the vendor sample on identical matrix size. Profiling with rocprof is unavailable but the correctness path passes. Suspect LDS bank conflicts on the column-major read of the shared tile.
expected_behavior: STATUS: PASS AND kernel completes within ~0.5 ms per iteration on 2048×2048.
actual_behavior: STATUS: PASS but ELAPSED_MS is 1.2–1.5 ms per iteration.
reproduction_hints: Shared memory tile is declared as `__shared__ float tile[32][32]`.
hygon DCU LDS has 32 banks × 4 bytes; column access `tile[x][y]` for y in 0..31 hits the same bank 32 times.
Fix candidate: pad the second dimension to 33 (`tile[32][33]`).
